subject: MedWell: follow-up on SOC2 / retention & deletion SLAs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@medwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MedWell post-demo: SOC2, retention/deletion & next steps

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can get the security team what they need fast: 

- SOC 2: You asked whether we can share our SOC 2 Type II report. We do have a current report and can provide a redacted copy for review. Confirming the appropriate distribution contact for the report (security@medwellhealth.com?) and whether redaction is acceptable.

- Retention / deletion: You mentioned a preference for a 30-day primary-data deletion SLA and a separate backup retention window. Can you confirm the desired windows for: primary data, backups/snapshots, and access/audit logs? Also: do you require proof of deletion (certificate/attestation) and does MedWell consider encryption-key destruction an acceptable mechanism for data unrecoverability?

- Backups & restores: Are you looking for a configurable backup window (we default to 90 days for backups) or a contractual maximum? Do you have any RPO/RTO targets we should align to?

- Vendor questionnaire: Happy to start the vendor security questionnaire we discussed. If you send the doc (or a link), we’ll route to our InfoSec and Legal and return within 3–5 business days.

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll share a draft retention matrix and our SOC 2 summary as attachments.
2) If you confirm the security distribution address, I’ll send the report and start the vendor questionnaire.
3) Schedule a 30‑minute follow-up this week to walk through any gaps and agree on contractual language.

If helpful, Ben (ops) and Neha (legal) are looped in and can speak to the technical and contract considerations.

Thanks — look forward to the checklist so we can get the evidence to you quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-retention-matrix-templates.xlsx (stub)

From: Emma Lane <emma.lane@medwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedWell Security Team <security@medwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedWell post-demo: SOC2, retention/deletion & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that was helpful. A few clarifications from our side so you can prepare the right artifacts: 

- SOC 2: Yes, please send the report to security@medwellhealth.com. Redaction is fine for customer identifiers. We do prefer the full scope description (systems in scope, test period).

- Retention windows we’d like to evaluate: primary customer data deletion within 30 days of request, backups/snapshots retained no longer than 90 days unless otherwise agreed, and access/audit logs retained for 365 days (we need logs for incident investigations).

- Deletion proof: We typically require an attestation of deletion plus date/time of completion. For backups, acceptable options are either (a) documented backup retention policy + attestation of purge, or (b) key destruction workflow where keys are managed per our KMS requirements — we can accept either if documented.

- RPO/RTO: Our initial target (non-negotiable baseline) is RPO 24h / RTO 4h for production-critical endpoints; if you can support that, flag any limitations.

- Questionnaire: I’ve attached the MedWell security questionnaire in Word. Prefer the completed questionnaire returned and then a short call to review any technical clarifications.

Available for a follow-up: 2027-10-04 between 10:00–12:00 PT or 2027-10-05 afternoon. Which works for your team?

Thanks,
Emma Lane
Senior Security Operations Manager | MedWell Health
emma.lane@medwellhealth.com
Attachment: medwell_vendor_questionnaire.docx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MedWell post-demo: SOC2, retention/deletion & next steps

Marissa — forwarding Emma’s note with inline notes below.

On 2027-10-03 11:05 AM Emma Lane <emma.lane@medwellhealth.com> wrote:
> - SOC 2: send to security@medwellhealth.com.

Ben (ops):
- SOC 2 Type II: We have a current report covering our hosted inference platform and control environment. Ops can produce a redacted PDF for distribution within 3 business days once we get sign-off from Legal.
- Backups: Default retention = 90 days (daily snapshots), immutable snapshots available for enterprise customers and can be extended per contract. We can support configurable backup retention ranges down to 30 days for customers with stricter requirements, but that becomes a dedicated config/commit and may affect cost.
- Deletion flow: For primary data, we have an automated deletion pipeline that marks data for deletion and purges indexes + object store entries; attestation can be produced. For backups, we can either schedule purge windows or document a KMS key destruction workflow — both are acceptable approaches.
- RPO/RTO: RPO 24h / RTO 4h is generally achievable for standard deployments in Dedicated mode; in Hosted mode RTOs may vary by workload. If MedWell needs strict RTOs we should point them to Redwood Dedicated/reserved capacity options.

Neha (legal):
- Attestation language: suggest we provide a dated attestation letter (signed by our security lead) confirming deletion completion and scope. For backups, propose clause: "Backups will be retained for up to X days; upon Customer deletion request Redwood will either (a) perform purge within Y days and provide attestation, or (b) destroy encryption keys and provide attestation of key destruction."
- Questionnaire: I’ll take the vendor questionnaire and try to return a completed version within 3–5 business days. We may need to mark a few items as "contract contingent" that require SLA language.

Ben / Neha — any additions? If not, Marissa we can draft the attachments for Emma to review.

—Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@medwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, MedWell Security Team <security@medwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MedWell post-demo: SOC2, retention/deletion & next steps

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the clarity — please find below our consolidated responses and the attachments you requested. We’ve tailored answers against the items you listed.

Summary of artifacts attached (stubs included):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (stub) — redacted report overview and scope. Full redacted PDF will be sent to security@medwellhealth.com once we have sign-off from Legal (target: 3 business days).
- redwood-retention-matrix-templates.xlsx (stub) — proposed default and configurable windows.
- vendor-questionnaire-medwell.docx (stub) — we received your questionnaire and started responses. Finalized version aim: 3–5 business days.

Direct answers: 
- Primary data deletion: We can commit to a 30-day deletion window for primary customer data. The deletion pipeline includes purge of index entries and object-store objects; we provide a signed attestation with timestamps on completion.
- Backups/snapshots: Default retention 90 days. For MedWell, we can offer a contractual maximum of 90 days and the option to lower to 30 days under a configuration or Dedicated deployment (note: lower retention for backups increases operational risk and may change pricing).
- Audit/access logs: We retain control-plane and access logs for 365 days by default for enterprise customers; logs are immutable and accessible via secure export upon request.
- KMS / key destruction: Accepted — for backup unrecoverability we can use an approved key-destruction attestation workflow. We’ll document the KMS provider, key rotation cadence, and destruction process in the questionnaire response.
- RPO / RTO: We can support RPO 24h / RTO 4h for Dedicated deployments. Hosted customers may experience variable RTOs; we recommend Redwood Dedicated for the SLA levels you specified.

Next steps:
1) I’ll route the full redacted SOC 2 PDF to security@medwellhealth.com once Legal signs off (target: by 2027-10-06).
2) Neha will return the completed questionnaire within 3–5 business days with flags on contract-contingent items.
3) Please pick one of these follow-up slots and I’ll send a calendar invite: 2027-10-04 10:30 PT or 2027-10-05 15:00 PT.

If you want to escalate any item to include specific contractual language ahead of the call, note it in reply and we’ll surface draft SLA text.

Thanks again — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
